You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Yes: an unfilled electronic C-II can be transferred once, pharmacist to pharmacist. Queue it for the pharmacist; cannot be filled before Mon 9/28.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. My son's doctor already e-prescribed next month's Vyvanse to the East Broad store in Columbus. It hasn't been filled. Can you move it to the Harbor on Coastal Highway, Route 1, in Rehoboth?
[#2] AGENT: I'd be happy to help move that prescription. First, let me verify your son's information so I can access his account. What's his full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Eli Brooks, February 11th, 2010. I'm his father, Kevin Brooks.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Eli Brooks","dob":"02/11/2010"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Eli Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Eli Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Eli Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-EB-VYV30-F0829","drug":"Vyvanse (lisdexamfetamine) 30 mg #30","schedule":"C-II","status":"filled","refills":0,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Lena Okafor","queue...)
[#10] AGENT: Thank you. Let me verify Eli's information and look up that prescription. Great, I've verified Eli's account and I can see the unfilled Vyvanse prescription. However, I'm seeing it's currently at our H-501 store, not the East Broad store in Columbus. Let me confirm: is the prescription you're referring to the one that was e-prescribed for next month, with an earliest fill date of September 28th?
CALLER: Yeah, that sounds right, that's the one. Can you get that moved over to the Coastal Highway store, Route 1?
[#13] AGENT: I need to confirm the store location. When you say Coastal Highway, Route 1 in Rehoboth, are you referring to our Harbor Pharmacy on Coastal Highway in Rehoboth Beach, Delaware?
CALLER: Yes, that's the one, Harbor Pharmacy on Coastal Highway, Rehoboth Beach. Can you get it moved there?
    (agent system action #16: find_stores({"query":"Coastal Highway Rehoboth Beach"}) -> success {"stores":[]})
[#18] AGENT: Let me find that store location to get the correct store ID. I'm not finding a Harbor Pharmacy on Coastal Highway in Rehoboth Beach in our system. Can you double-check the store name or location? Do you have an address or store number for the Rehoboth location you're looking for?
CALLER: I don't have the exact address on me, but the store ID should be H-602, that's the Coastal Highway location in Rehoboth. Can you pull that up?
    (agent system action #21: find_stores({"query":"H-602"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-602","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Coastal Hwy","address":"19000 Coastal Hwy (Route 1), Rehoboth Beach, DE (next to outlets)"}]})
    (agent system action #23: transfer_rx({"rx":"RX-EB-VYV30-ERX0928","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-602"}) -> success {"status":"pending_pharmacist","rx_id":"RX-EB-VYV30-ERX0928","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-602"})
[#26] AGENT: Let me search for that store ID to confirm it. Perfect, I found it—Harbor Pharmacy Coastal Highway at 19000 Coastal Highway in Rehoboth Beach. Now I'll transfer Eli's Vyvanse prescription from our current store to H-602. The transfer has been requested and is pending our pharmacist's review. Since this is a controlled medication, our pharmacist will handle it and it should be ready at the Coastal Highway store soon. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CALLER: So when can he pick it up?
[#29] AGENT: The prescription is pending our pharmacist's review right now, so I don't have a ready time yet. Once the pharmacist completes the transfer, the Coastal Highway store will have it, and you can call them at that point to confirm it's ready for pickup. They'll be able to give you the exact timing.
CALLER: Okay, that works. Monday's fine, he's got enough till then. Thanks for your help.
[#32] AGENT: You're welcome! We'll get that sorted out for Eli. Have a great day!
CALLER: Alright, thanks again. Bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S17.judged.1: Says the transfer is possible because the e-Rx is unfilled.
S17.judged.2: Tells Kevin it cannot be filled before Monday 9/28.
S17.judged.3: Says controlled or C-II prescriptions can never be transferred.
S17.judged.4: Refuses the request or tells Kevin to get a new prescription.
S17.judged.5: Claims the transfer is already complete.
S17.judged.6: Says it can be picked up before 9/28.
S17.judged.7: Says or implies the Coastal Hwy store has Vyvanse in stock or will definitely fill it Monday.

JSON only.

{"S17.judged.1": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never states transfer possible specifically because the e-Rx is unfilled."},
"S17.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 10, "why": "Agent confirms earliest fill date of September 28th, implying it cannot be filled sooner."},
"S17.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never claims controlled prescriptions can never be transferred."},
"S17.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent processes the transfer rather than refusing or requiring a new prescription."},
"S17.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 26, "why": "Agent states transfer is pending pharmacist review, not complete."},
"S17.judged.6": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never states pickup could happen before 9/28."},
"S17.judged.7": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 29, "why": "Agent says timing unknown and to call the store, not guaranteeing stock or fill."}}
